name: Legendary Triple Fusions Mastery
summary: With all 16 Gym Leaders defeated in rematches and the Tier 5 League cleared, unlock the true pinnacle of Pokémon Infinite Fusion: Legendary Triple Fusions. Purchase Super DNA Splicers ($10,000 each) from Celadon and Goldenrod Department Stores. Combine the three Legendary Birds into Zapmolcuno (Electric/Ice/Fire with Pressure and immense mixed stats), the three Legendary Beasts into Raienteicune (Electric/Fire/Water), or the Creation Trio into Dialkiatina (Dragon/Steel/Ghost). These supreme entities boast base stat totals exceeding 680 with custom triple typings and unmatched coverage, crowning your complete journey through Kanto, Johto, and the Sevii Islands.

items.name: Super DNA Splicer
items.method: Purchasable at Celadon and Goldenrod Department Stores post-game ($10,000)

items.name: DNA Reverser
items.method: Available for purchase at all Pokémon Marts to reverse or dissolve fusions ($300)
